result: EXACT: primal graph K5, internal dual K4, exterior-augmented dual K5. The four-cell ball is the boundary of a 4-simplex minus one open tetrahedral facet. Adding that facet changes Betti numbers from (1,0,0,0) to (1,0,0,1) with the graph fixed. Complex vertex automorphisms:24 versus graph120. Under H=I, closed-boundary spectrum is lambda^2*(lambda^2+5)^14.
